name: Piyestra Super Flex Spring Mattress
description: 7-inch Piyestra Super Flex spring mattress built with heat-treated high-tensile springs, high-density foam layers, and a quilted fabric cover. Backed by a 15-year spring structure warranty.
details: The Piyestra Super Flex Spring Mattress is engineered to provide responsive orthopaedic support and lasting sleeping comfort for Sri Lankan bedrooms. Constructed with a durable heat-treated high-tensile spring unit, high-density cushioning foam, and a protective coir layer, it distributes body weight evenly while preventing sagging. Finished with a breathable, dust-proof quilted fabric cover, this 7-inch mattress comes backed by a 15-year manufacturer warranty on the spring structure and a 2-year warranty on the foam layers.
